description: Header file defining the QuicPacketNumber class, which manages packet number representation, initialization state, and related operations in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicPacketNumber
classes.description: Represents a QUIC packet number, supporting initialization, comparison, increment/decrement, and conversion to uint64_t.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the packet number to uninitialized state.

methods.name: UpdateMax
methods.description: Updates the packet number to the maximum of current and new value.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Returns a hash value of the packet number.

methods.name: ToUint64
methods.description: Converts the packet number to a uint64_t.

methods.name: IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the packet number is initialized.

methods.name: operator+=
methods.description: Adds delta to the packet number.

methods.name: operator-=
methods.description: Subtracts delta from the packet number.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the packet number.
